title: Rancor
description: Rancors were towering hulks with reptilian flesh that were sometimes kept as pets or mounts. Jabba the Hutt kept one in a shadowy chamber beneath his throne room, and would feed those who displeased him to it. However, Luke Skywalker put an end to that. Jabba's cousins, the Twins, gave Boba Fett a rancor as a gift to make up for their treachery. The notorious bounty hunter then foiled the Twins in their bid to take over Jabba's old territory. Fett, with the help of his own rancor keeper, rode the rancor into battle against the Pyke Syndicate in Mos Espa.
